subject: Activation: Silkway Pilot — Sales to CS Transition & Escalation Plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai; Saira Khan <saira@silkway.ai>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@silkway.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation: Silkway Pilot — Sales to CS Transition & Escalation Plan

Hi team and Saira/Tom,

Quick handoff note now that Silkway signed the pilot LOI (deal id RDW-DEAL-2028-1389). High level context below — please treat this thread as the single source for kickoff logistics and early escalations.

Why this pilot matters
- Customer: Silkway AI (customer-facing conversational assistant for logistics).
- Scope: 90-day pilot, Redwood hosted inference (g6-small -> quantized variant), up to 8k tokens/session; expected baseline 15 reqs/sec with spikes to ~60 RPS during peak scheduling windows.
- Success criteria (customer): 99th percentile latency < 400ms for 2k token responses, integration with SAML SSO, and ability to store evaluation-only logs for 30 days.

Key commercial notes
- Credits: We agreed to 3 months of trial credits covering compute and up to 50M tokens.
- Legal/Procurement: SOW in negotiation — attach draft (SOW-Silkway-Draft.docx). We have an open DocuSign for the final SOW.

Risks & constraints
- Data residency: Silkway requires EU-only processing for a subset of PII datasets. They will keep those datasets in their EU tenant; we need to confirm routing policy and model shard placement.
- Auth: SAML attributes need mapping for role-based rate limits.
- Integration: They will forward a sample dataset (~2.4GB compressed) and a Jira project for issue tracking.

Immediate asks for CS/Eng
1) Marissa — own the pilot (primary CS). Match cadence and reporting to customer success playbook.
2) Karthik — lead technical onboarding and runtime config (quantization profile, batching thresholds).
3) Tessa — PM for timeline, milestones, and weekly standups.
4) All internal — please review the attached Mutual Action Plan (Silkway_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf) and update the plan before our kickoff.

Planned kickoff: Tue May 9, 10:00–11:00 PT (tentative). Marissa, can you confirm and send meeting invite?

Customer contacts: Saira Khan (CTO) and Tom Liu (Head of Integrations). They will provide a short dataset and a Jira project key ahead of the kickoff.

Attachments: Silkway_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf, SOW-Silkway-Draft.docx

Thanks — I’ll stay on as the primary escalation for commercial items during the pilot.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Saira Khan <saira@silkway.ai>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@silkway.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation: Silkway Pilot — Sales to CS Transition & Escalation Plan

Thanks Vivek — looping in internal owners and confirming next steps. I will be the primary CS lead for the pilot.

Assigning roles:
- Marissa Cole (primary CS, kickoff facilitator, weekly status reports)
- Karthik Iyer (technical lead, runtime tuning, test harness, preprod validation)
- Tessa Morgan (program manager, milestone tracker, stakeholder communications)

I scheduled the kickoff for Tue May 9 at 10:00 PT and sent a calendar invite to the thread — please confirm availability.

Immediate blockers I need before the kickoff:
- HubSpot deal notes and any procurement/redline history (Vivek, can you paste the latest negotiation points or link the DocuSign record?)
- Access: a short-lived API key for staging + a sample payload/schema and the ~2.4GB sample dataset (we can provide an S3 presigned URL for upload).
- SSO details: who owns SAML metadata at Silkway and a test IdP endpoint.

Risks called out for the playbook
- EU-residency flow will require explicit routing to EU-hosted nodes — if this requires a Private deployment path we need to escalate early.
- Large-batch evaluation runs during training windows may push beyond agreed credits if not throttled; will add throttle rules to the mutual action plan.

I attached a short runtime notes file (runtime_profile_notes.md) with initial questions about model variant and batching heuristics Karthik and I can fill in.

@Saira / @Tom — thanks for quick turnaround here. If you can share the Jira project key and a looker/access list for the sample data that will speed the kickoff.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation: Silkway Pilot — Sales to CS Transition & Escalation Plan

Adding technical notes and a short checklist.

Quick answers / asks:
- Model: we'll serve 'g6-small-quant' for the pilot; please confirm if Silkway needs alternative prompts or a fallback smaller model for low-cost routes.
- Token distribution: estimate ~1.2k avg tokens per session (customer provided sample looks chatty). We'll enable KV caching and a 512-prefix cache for repeated prompts.
- Batching: target batch window 12–20ms during low latency mode, but we should allow a burst policy to 50ms for peak tolerance.

What I need from Silkway before the kickoff:
1) A sanitized sample of 200 representative sessions (JSONL) so we can run local latency sims.
2) Any custom tokens or stop sequences used by their system.
3) Staging API credentials + host allowlist (we will provide log endpoints).

Potential tech escalations:
- If they require EU-only inference for PII we might need dedicated nodes or a Dedicated contract add-on. Flagging for finance/procurement if that triggers a pricing change.

I attached runtime_profile_notes.md with a short table of parameter suggestions. I’ll start the load tests once we get the JSONL sample.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Staff ML Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Saira Khan <saira@silkway.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 05 May 2028 08:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Activation: Silkway Pilot — Sales to CS Transition & Escalation Plan

Marissa / team — thanks for the quick handoff. Confirming Tue May 9 at 10:00 PT works for our engineering and security leads. We will:
- Share a sanitized sample dataset (we will create 200 sessions JSONL and upload a zipped file to the S3 bucket you provide).
- Create a Jira project: SILK-PILOT-23 and will invite your team.
- Send SAML metadata and identify point-of-contact: Priya Verma (security@silkway.ai).

One ask: please include a short runbook for how we can pause the pilot and drain traffic if we encounter PII leakage during early tests. We want clear rollback steps.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Saira Khan
CTO, Silkway AI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Activation: Silkway Pilot — Sales to CS Transition & Escalation Plan

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple of quick commercial notes for the record:
- I’ve posted the final credit memo to HubSpot and linked the DocuSign envelope. Please do not bill the account while the trial credits remain — finance is aware.
- If EU-only processing causes us to recommend Dedicated, I will loop in Sales Engineering + BD for pricing; Karthik, please flag if that becomes necessary.

Marissa — please keep me on the weekly reporting thread (I’ll step out of day-to-day unless an escalation is needed).

Thanks everyone — see you at the kickoff.

— Vivek
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
